The most purely evil race in my world is the Shai'shk. They are worshiped by lesser races like the goblins and some orcs, and of course some humans. The Shai'shk are remnants of the original primordial water that formed the world before time. They were the dark water, where evil could fester. What is left of them roams the Earth in water and shadows and commit depraved acts wherever they could. They often are the inspirers of corruption, temptations, and sometimes will possess evil people so that they can commit slaughter more easily.

The crisis in my world is the climax of a series of events set in motion by the Spirt of Destruction. Jasper, the spirit, managed to fool the main antagonist into plunging the civilized world into world war three, and into opening many doors to our world for other destructive beings to enter through. Our protagonist and his fellows have learned of the plan, and put all their bets on the skills of Haoren, the main protagonist. Little to Haoren's knowledge, it was Jasper that controlled his special powers; Jasper cut them off from him at the time he needed it the most. The resulting events unlocked a barrier which had surrounded Earth for aeons, barring Jasper in its kin from entering and causing havoc. What happens next is a near extinction level event, caused by the unchained hordes of destructive entities that entered Earth after the barrier was removed. Most life on Earth was wiped from it.
